editorial:
Imagine you are trapped in a small village where everyone knows your business. You will meet a woman who is bored with her marriage and falls deeply in love with another man. Together, they decide to get rid of her husband in the most brutal way possible by throwing him down a deep well. The movie feels heavy and steamy, focusing on how their love turns into a nightmare. You can feel the heat and the stress as they try to act normal while the whole town starts wondering where the husband went.

The acting is top-notch and makes the tension feel real, though some parts move a bit slow. You will love the way the ghost story blends with the crime plot. If you like old-school dramas with a dark twist, you should definitely give this a try. It looks great if you can find it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is a quick way to check it out. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: As the guilt and fear grow, the couple completely falls apart. They cannot escape the ghost of the husband or the eyes of the villagers. In the end, their secret comes out and their passion turns into hate. They end up dying in a violent way, showing that their crime was too big to get away with. It is a sad and bloody finish that proves love built on a murder never lasts.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark romance and old Japanese cinema.
